title: No Thunderstorms in Seeker's Castle
summary: Squeaky the balloon dog has one more question for Frankar: why did he run his big experiment on the night of a thunderstorm? Frankar explains that he never meant to. When he was just a little kid, everybody else was deep down in the mountain at a feast, but he wanted to do his own thing, so he slipped up to his room with the window he had carved to watch the sky and poured magical energy into a machine meant to hold all the perfect answers. It glowed, it shook, it rattled — and then a flash, a crack and a boom opened a portal to the Plane of Fire right under his feet. Isabella has advice for him: if you're going to live in Seeker's Castle, ask Seeker whether it's safe, and if he says no, listen. Frankar points out that Seeker used to blow things up all the time when they were kids, but the brothers strike a deal — anything that glows, sparks, smokes or explodes happens outside, maybe in a special sandpit, and never in a thunderstorm. Squeaky is scared of popping but wants to learn anyway, Isabella offers her book of experiments (just avoid the unsafe ones), and everyone drinks the going home potion.

characters.name: Frankar
characters.description: Seeker's little brother, a dwarf slightly taller and skinnier than Seeker, with neatly combed shoulder-length black hair, black mustachios, a long straight black beard and a neat white cloak; newly escaped from the Plane of Fire, he can only sleep in a room that glows and flickers like flames, and likes his toast burnt.

characters.name: Squeaky the Doggo
characters.description: A purple shiny balloon dog who works at the Balloon Twisting School.

characters.name: Seeker
characters.description: A brave dwarven explorer and mediator, he resides in a glowing castle hub—a multiversal dock for skyships anchored within the skyline of New York City. From this urban sanctum, he conducts silver slime experiments and tends to wandering cats amidst a massive library. Frequently swapping between a red coat and a mystical purple cloak, his braided red beard remains his most eccentric tool, capable of catching small fish. A master of fusion, he combines ancient stone-craft with high-velocity mechanics, utilizing a legendary magic ladder to scale the shifting architecture of the realms. Whether brewing portal potions, harvesting floof-berries in Limbo with gemstone goggles, or aiding Buddy the Mouse, this walnut-loving student of the stars remains the hero who orchestrated the daring rescue of the world.

characters.name: Isabella
characters.description: A towering Dimitar scholar and alchemist of Atsukeeseet, Mama Izzy is a clever kiddo at heart and a steadfast guardian of rooftop gardens and intricate dollhouses. Gifted with the power of flight, she navigates the open heights with aquatic grace, her massive frame often shielded by a special protective metal that glimmers even as she descends into the shadows. As a resourceful quartermaster, she employs red flashlights, gold-laced slimes, and pipe cleaners to mend a Lanternshark’s failing light, yet her generosity remains her hallmark; she freely shares her vast library, brokers homes for dragons, and teaches others to find the resonance in their own voices. Her most profound magic resides in her vast, soft blanket—a sanctuary of ultimate coziness—where she remains a brave, quick-witted protector to all who honor her singular request for absolute silence.

characters.name: Shrew-like
characters.description: A tiny shrew-like prehistoric creature who hitches a ride back in Jane's pocket and moves into Isabella's dollhouse.

places.name: Seeker's Castle
places.description: Behind an unassuming facade and a solitary doorbell lies Seeker’s home, a sprawling magical fortress that serves as a vital sanctuary for weary legends. The interior expands into a labyrinthine refuge where an expansive library of mystical books towers beside a potion closet that acts as the true gateway to adventure. This fortress is a hub for calls to action and well-earned rest, where Wobbly Whiskers waits to greet the Seeker and Buddy the Mouse—though the warmth of their homecoming is inevitably punctuated by his latest sticky mess upon the rug.

places.name: The Plane of Fire
places.description: A scorching, sparkly realm filled with volcanoes, campfires, and bright floating lights.
